svg.title: T15.6_final_decoder_evidence_report
svg.text: T15.6 Final Decoder Verification Evidence Report
A sign-off package connects protocol evidence, model results, RTL regression, coverage, synthesis boundaries and known limits.

text.tspan: TS package, section, table, formula, local path,
DC availability, timing, area, power, constraints,

Final evidence is not a narrative summary. It is an indexed proof that every claim has a source, command, artifact, result and limitation. Current repository evidence includes plans, scripts and audits; unavailable tools and missing real reports must remain explicit limitations.
TS, Rel-19 package, section, table/figure/formula, local path
Use extracted 3GPP_Rel19/processed artifacts and upstream lessons
seed, Eb/N0, vector id, command, BLER/BER or bit-exact result
T12/T13 plans and toy snippets exist; no full BLER campaign here
LLR width, saturation, loss budget, bit-exact diff, trace hash
T13 model plans define fields; final report records real run status
testbench, directed vector suite, assertions, reset/timeout, coverage bins
T15.1-T15.3 define architecture and gates; real simulator not run
DC version, library, SDC, WNS/TNS, area, power, timing fixes
DC not installed; no mapped netlist or true reports in current environment
all vectors cite exact TS package and local extracted path
aggregate wording, missing section, or unverified table
seeded commands, thresholds and bit-exact summaries archived
missing seed, missing threshold, unexplained mismatch
directed suites pass and expected-fail classes match
required bins hit and waivers approved
unhit critical cross or unclassified failure
reports archived or unavailable boundary stated
claiming timing closure without real report
owner, impact, close condition and waiver expiry recorded
Audit-ready rule: every green cell must name the command or file that proves it. A not-run item is acceptable only when it is explicit, scoped and assigned a close condition.
